title: Momoi Airi — One Of The Fans〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, I didn't make a single mistake this time!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, that looked pretty good!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you, Len. This is a difficult dance, but you've really helped us get the hang of it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I'm glad I could help you two.
Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Welcome, Airi!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You went over to see how Shizuku was doing, yes? How was she...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, she was practicing like there was no tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
She seemed so focused...
I got goosebumps just watching her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's been a long time since she last gave off this sort of vibe.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A long time?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah... It reminds me of when I was still a trainee.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A trainee? As in, before you debuted with QT?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. Back then, I practiced like crazy every single day in order to rise above my peers.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Trainees of the same cohort are supposed to work together to improve, but they're also rivals competing for a limited number of debut spots.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In other words, because there are only a limited number of spots, not everyone gets to make their debut.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. That's why I did absolutely everything in my power to get the attention of anyone I could, and show them that I'm the brightest star.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A reminder of how tough show business really is...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's incredible to think that you were able to win one of those spots and make your big debut.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To be fair, I had a lot of luck on my side.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we're talking about when I was a trainee.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right now, Shizuku is practicing even harder than I ever did back then.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It's like when she'd just become the lead for Cheerful * Days...
No, more than that...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She sent shivers down my spine. She was that cool.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which is why...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I believe she's gonna find a way to succeed.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If the people from that production company saw her now, I bet their jaws would be on the floor.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? What's so funny...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, nothing. It's just...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Shizuku must be so happy knowing that she has a loyal fan such as yourself supporting her.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, she's so blessed as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, me? Shizuku's fan...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, I wasn't trying to say that...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But your eyes sparkled so much while you were talking about her just now!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, she'd probably love to hear everything you just said.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, don't you dare tell her!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
A-Anyway, we need to start practicing!
And you two are gonna help us, Len, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Of course!
